events.title: Events
events.description: Every event of the division, drafts and past ones included: its settings, its description, its airports with their capacity, and cancelling or deleting it.
events.readOnly: You can read this event: changing it is for whoever writes the events.

delete.title: Delete this event?
delete.description: The event and its airports are deleted for good. An event somebody took part in cannot be deleted: cancel it instead.

body.unsaved: The description has changes that are not saved.

hints.kind: A kind of the division's calendar. Choosing it sets the switches below to what the settings of the events say of that kind; change them as this event needs.
hints.publicSlots: Slots the staff prepares, each with its flight, which a pilot books.
hints.privateSlots: Slots generated from the capacity of each airport, for the flight a pilot chooses.
hints.wholeDivision: The event is about every airport and position of the division, as an online day is: it has no airports of its own.
hints.externalUrl: For an event of the network or of another division: their page about it.
hints.visibleFromUtc: Leave it empty to show the event as soon as it is published.
hints.bookingOpensAtUtc: From when pilots book; each slot closes at its own off block time. Leave it empty for an event without slots.

cancel.title: Cancel the event
cancel.description: The event stays on its page until its end, marked as cancelled, with the note below.

hints.note: Shown on the page of the event, in every language of the division.

hints.maxMovementsPerHour: The capacity of the airport, as arrivals and departures together. Leave it empty to give arrivals and departures apart.
hints.maxArrivalsPerHour: With the departures, instead of the movements.

delete.title: Delete this airport?
delete.description: The airport is taken out of the event.

settings.title: Events settings
settings.description: What the events department changes without a release: what each kind of event switches on, the distance between two bookings of a pilot, how long the pilots' bookings are kept, the reminder.

fields.kindPresets: What each kind of event switches on
fields.bookingGapMinutes: Minutes between two bookings of the same pilot
fields.pilotRetentionMonths: Months the pilots' bookings are kept after an event
fields.reminderLeadHours: Hours before the off block time the reminder is sent

hints.kindPresets: A new event of that kind starts with these switches on, and the staff can still change them on the event. The kinds are the words of the calendar. No row: a new event starts with every switch off.
hints.bookingGapMinutes: Two bookings of one pilot in the same event are at least this far apart, one way or the other, so that one flight can end before the next starts.
hints.pilotRetentionMonths: After this many months from the end of an event, the bookings and the reports of support of its pilots are deleted.
hints.reminderLeadHours: The pilot receives the reminder of a booking this many hours before its off block time.

eventCancelled.title: Cancelled events
eventCancelled.description: An email when an event you booked a slot of, have a shift in or registered for is cancelled, with the reason.

eventCancelled.subject: [Events] Cancelled: {{event}}

errors.calendarKindUnknown: This is no longer a kind of the calendar: take the row out.
errors.kindTwice: This kind has more than one row.
errors.endsBeforeItStarts: The event ends before it starts.
errors.visibilityChoice: An event is seen by everybody or by the members.
errors.wholeDivisionHasAirports: This event has airports of its own: take them out before making it about the whole division.
errors.wholeDivisionHasNoAirports: An event about the whole division has no airports of its own.
errors.airportUnknown: The hub does not know this airport.
errors.airportTwice: This airport is already in the event.
errors.capacityEitherOr: Give the movements, or the arrivals and the departures: not both.
errors.eventOver: This event is over: it cannot be cancelled any more.
